title: Quantum-Inspired Modeling of Driving Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2608.25907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Driver behavior is heterogeneous, context-dependent, and changes over time, and these properties shape the traffic phenomena we observe. Most models, however, fix in advance which behavioral variables interact and how. Behavior outside that form is absorbed as noise, while models flexible enough to capture it tend to lose interpretability. We introduce a quantum-inspired representation of driver behavior that combines properties usually treated separately or in part: it is continuous, probabilistic, context-dependent, history-dependent, and represents interactions among behavioral variables as learned from data. Each driver is encoded as an evolving density matrix, providing a unified representation of behavioral uncertainty, temporal evolution, and context-dependent behavioral variation. Trained without supervision on the I-24 MOTION dataset, the framework recovers three interpretable driving profiles representing three regimes: free fl

translated_title: 量子启发的驾驶行为建模
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25907v1 公告类型：新 摘要：驾驶员行为具有异质性、上下文依赖性，并随时间变化，这些特性塑造了我们观察到的交通现象。然而，大多数模型事先固定了哪些行为变量相互作用以及如何作用。超出该形式的行为被吸收为噪声，而能够灵活捕捉这些行为的模型往往失去可解释性。我们引入了一种量子启发的驾驶员行为表示，它结合了通常被分开或部分处理的特性：它是连续的、概率性的、上下文依赖的、历史依赖的，并基于数据学习行为变量间的相互作用。每个驾驶员被编码为一个演化的密度矩阵，提供了行为不确定性、时间演化和上下文依赖行为变化的统一表示。该框架在I-24 MOTION数据集上无监督训练，恢复了三种可解释的驾驶模式，代表三种状态：自由流动
tldr: 本文提出一种量子启发的驾驶行为模型，通过密度矩阵统一表示驾驶员行为的连续性、概率性、上下文和历史依赖性，并在无监督下从数据中学习，恢复了三种可解释的驾驶模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a quantum-inspired driving behavior model that unifies continuity, probability, context-dependence, and history-dependence via density matrices, learning interpretable driving profiles unsupervised from data.
